about.title: About Me
about.text1: With over 8 years of experience, my passion is transforming ideas into clean and functional code. I specialize in Drupal for complex content management systems and Laravel for custom back-end applications. While my main focus is on these technologies, I also work with Vue, PostgreSQL, MySQL, JavaScript, jQuery, Cypress and complex API implementation.
about.text2: I hold a degree in Information Systems with specialization in Software Engineering, which provides me with a solid foundation to architect and build robust and scalable solutions.
about.text3: My work philosophy is centered on clarity and quality. I believe that well-done documentation and well-defined requirements are the foundation for the success of any project, being an indispensable rule for me.
about.text4: I always seek the balance between design and functionality, ensuring that each project is not only beautiful, but also intuitive and accessible.
